summary: The predecessor fixture validated seeded production with Spring.GetUnitCommands(factory, 4), while official stock Recoil 2639 routes a factory GetUnitCommands read to newUnitCommands, the rally queue. Production is exposed by GetFactoryCommands over commandQue. The earlier mock aliased its rally and production concepts, so it could pass while exercising the wrong API. The repaired fixture uses GetFactoryCommands and its stock-faithful mock keeps a positive production queue beside an empty rally queue; an old-API mutant now refuses. This is retained historical BAR knowledge at the cited capture; recheck applicability before using it on a successor.
title: Aliased fixture mocks hid the stock production-queue API mismatch
